slug: 2026-06-19 Strategy Ahead of Infrastructure, Part II The Opportunity and the Case for Sequencing

facts.fact: Analysis states that Central Bank of Nigeria circular PSS/DIR/PUB/CIR/001/004 of 15 June 2026 requires payment data to be stored and managed in Nigeria by January 2027.
Analysis presents the CBN as issuer of the June 2026 payments circular whose data localisation pillar binds payment institutions, and expects CBN supervisory discretion over the deadline.
